beats.anchor: Puis ses pieds se mettent à danser tout seuls.
beats.extras: Youssef, 13, captain of the Moroccan academy: a slim boy from Fès with light olive brown skin, short tight dark curls, very thick dark eyebrows that almost meet in the middle, a captain's armband on his left arm over a red training top with a small green star, leaning over the railing and waving. On the balcony behind him, four or five Moroccan boys of 12 and 13 in the same red training tops, clapping and singing; one of them taps a darbouka, a small hourglass shaped clay drum, held under his arm.
beats.outfit: BriBri (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band, green shorts, his red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot in scuffed white sneakers, his soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth showing. Kaydoudou (13) in his green sweatshirt and jeans, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: On the pavement below the balcony, BriBri dances with his knees bent and both arms in the air, laughing, up on the tips of his toes. Above him, Youssef leans over the railing with a big grin and beckons him to come up. A few steps behind, Kaydoudou stands with his hands in his pockets, watching his little brother with a small half smile.
beats.location: A seafront street in a small Catalan coastal town at night: a white beach hotel with a lit balcony one floor up, palm trees, a long row of plain coloured tournament flags on poles snapping in the wind, the dark sea beyond the promenade.
beats.light: Blue dusk sky over the sea, warm yellow light spilling from the balcony and the street lamps onto the dancers.
beats.camera: Medium shot from street level, slightly low, the balcony and Youssef in the upper part of the frame, BriBri dancing in the lower centre, Kaydoudou at the right edge.
beats.alt: Sous le balcon de l'Académie de l'Atlas, BriBri danse sur le trottoir pendant que Youssef lui fait signe de monter.

beats.anchor: Puis il la renverse d'un coup.
beats.extras: Jordi Puig, 45, the coach: a calm white Catalan man with a short salt and pepper beard, a flat carpenter's pencil behind his ear, a navy club jacket, crouching on one knee. Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with a brown bun, freckles, a small white scar on her knee and her socks rolled down. Nil Soler, 13: a tall, very thin white boy with sticking out ears and a serious face. Pol Vidal: a tall, broad white striker of 13. All three in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (13) in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band and number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. BriBri (12) in the same sand gold kit, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his soft little afro damp with sweat.
beats.action: At half time, the players sit or kneel in a half circle on the grass. Jordi tips a plastic water bottle upside down all at once, and the water hits the grass in one big silver splash. Kaydoudou leans forward, frowning, studying the splash. BriBri's eyes go wide and round, his mouth opening in an O as an idea arrives. Laia, Nil and Pol stare, puzzled.
beats.location: The grass at the edge of a youth tournament pitch by the sea in Catalonia, a few kit bags and water bottles on the ground, a low stand with red flags and drums blurred in the background, the blue sea beyond.
beats.light: Warm late afternoon May sun, the splash of water sparkling in the light.
beats.camera: Medium shot at grass level, the splash in the centre foreground, the circle of faces around it.
beats.alt: À la mi-temps, Jordi renverse d'un coup sa bouteille d'eau sur l'herbe et BriBri ouvre de grands yeux.

beats.anchor: Un contrôle vers l'avant, un regard, et le ballon glissé à ras de terre, au premier poteau.
beats.extras: The Atlas goalkeeper: a Moroccan boy of 13 with brown skin and short black hair, in a long sleeved dark grey goalkeeper kit and gloves, diving full length the wrong way. Two Atlas players of 13 in red shirts with a green star, chasing far behind, too late. In the stand behind the goal, Moroccan families with red flags bearing a green star and drums, and Catalan villagers, all on their feet.
beats.outfit: BriBri (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band and green shorts, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot. Kaydoudou (13), far in the background, in the same sand gold kit with number 8, the blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Frozen at the moment of the shot: BriBri, twenty metres from goal, has just slid the ball low with the inside of his foot toward the near post; his body leans forward, eyes on the ball, perfectly calm. The ball skims the grass just past the diving goalkeeper's fingers. Far behind, Kaydoudou still has his arm stretched out after his long pass, watching.
beats.location: A small tournament stadium by the sea in Catalonia, a low stand packed with spectators behind the goal, a row of plain coloured flags on poles above the stand.
beats.light: Golden late afternoon sun, long shadows on the grass, the slow motion feeling of dust and grass flecks hanging in the air.
beats.camera: Low dynamic angle from beside the near post, the ball rushing toward the camera, BriBri sharp in the middle ground, the goalkeeper diving across the frame, the crowd soft behind.
beats.alt: Au ralenti, BriBri glisse le ballon à ras de terre au premier poteau et le gardien de l'Atlas plonge trop tard.
